title: At least four symbols: one split per round
notes: Each round can only tell apart states one symbol further from the accept state, so this chain takes three rounds to split into five blocks, and a fourth to see that nothing more splits: the most rounds five states can need.
ops: start q0; accept q4; q0 a -> q1; q1 a -> q2; q2 a -> q3; q3 a -> q4; q4 a -> q4
